answer: Joining costs one bond of 400 POA locked for 200 days against a single quartz-signed hardware key, so a farm cannot split one payment across a thousand fake agents. Every quarter, five auditors chosen at random from the bonded reef review each agent's work and vote on whether it is real. A caught fake loses the whole 400 POA and its key is barred for a year, and the forfeited bond pays the auditors who caught it. That lock pushes any payoff past the horizon where a quick flip makes sense.
